svg.title: Lower bound trace for target 5 on [1, 3, 5, 5, 8, 12, 15]
svg.desc: Step 1: lo 0, mid 3, hi 7; nums[3]=5 >= 5 so hi = 3. Step 2: lo 0, mid 1, hi 3; nums[1]=3 < 5 so lo = 2. Step 3: lo 2, mid 2, hi 3; nums[2]=5 >= 5 so hi = 2. Done: lo = hi = 2. Red cells are ruled out as too small, green cells are known to be at least 5, violet is mid; indices 0..1 hold values below 5, indices 2..6 hold values at least 5.
